A Midnight Vietnamese Delight: Unexpected Culinary Bliss
Oct 2024 • Solo
I was walking the street, I was so hungry and I didn’t expect anything because it’s already midnight but to my surprise this restaurant gave me one of the best Vietnamese cuisine I have tried in my life. It late but the ingredients are still so fresh. I ordered one of my favorite Vietnamese food Beef Pho and I partnered it along with Friend Vegetable Spring Roll. All I can say I will definitely come back for the food. 
Great customer service as they welcome me to the restaurant and very proactive to my needs. Though it’s midnight, but the vibe of the staff are exceeding my expectations. They even help me book my grab to my hotel. It’s also a plus point to me whenever the restaurant accept card payments. Overall, they have shown me the true Vietnamese culture through good food and people.
